title: pvRandomAttributes
body:
## pvRandomAttributes

Adds random-valued arrays to a dataset, composite dataset or hyper-tree grid: point and/or cell scalars (1 component) and vectors (3 components) of the chosen DataType, each component drawn between the two ComponentRange values. By ParaView default only cell vectors of unsigned char in [0, 255] are generated. Generated arrays become the active attributes. Use it for test data or to colour blocks distinctly (AttributesConstantPerBlock).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Values are pseudo-random and not guaranteed reproducible between runs; do not use them in results that are compared exactly.
- Integer data types truncate the range; use Float or Double for continuous values.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `RandomAttributes`. Identity: `filters/RandomAttributeGenerator`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Random Scalars filter. Accepted data: composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AttributesConstantPerBlock` | Indicate that the generated attributes are constant within a block. This can be used to highlight blocks in a composite dataset. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComponentRange` | Set the range values (minimum and maximum) for each component. This applies to all data that is generated. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1]` |
| `DataType` | Specify the type of array to create (all components of this array are of this type). This holds true for all arrays that are created. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Bit","Char","UnsignedChar","Short","UnsignedShort","Int","UnsignedInt","Long","UnsignedLong","Float","Double","vtkIdType"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Bit"` |
| `GenerateCellScalars` | When true, adds a 1-component random cell array (each value drawn between the ComponentRange bounds, of type DataType). The upstream ParaView text says "point scalars"; this property generates cell scalars. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateCellVectors` | When true, adds a 3-component random cell array (each component drawn between the ComponentRange bounds). The upstream ParaView text says "point vectors"; this property generates cell vectors, and it is the one array type ParaView enables by default. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GeneratePointScalars` | Indicate that point scalars are to be generated. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GeneratePointVectors` | Indicate that point vectors are to be generated. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

```json
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvRandomAttributes",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
